data.name: S.E.R.T
data.detailed_description:
Join fellow members of the elite Supernatural Emergency Response Team (S.E.R.T) as you rescue victims of paranormal entities!

S.E.R.T is a mix of a tactical FPS and a medical simulation game. Paranormal entities like living shadows, fire spirits, and even the undead have been reported inside several locations. Your job, as a S.E.R.T operator, is to stop the threat, find and treat the survivors, and get them out.

S.E.R.T is played entirely in co-op multiplayer. It is designed for 2-6 players, but you can play completely solo if you wish. You can pick from a variety of difficulty levels to tailor your experience, whether you prefer combat, patient care, or a combination in between.

Customize your loadout and appearance!

As you rescue more patients and stop more anomalies, you will gain money and experience. This allows you to unlock more advanced rescue and fighting equipment, from incense and table salt, to flashbangs and breaching charges. Customize your character to your liking, from your uniform and equipment to the patches on your helmet.

Engage and eliminate anomalous threats!

If you're a fan of tactical FPS gameplay and fast-paced room clearing, you've come to the right place. Break down doors and directly engage anomalous entities to eliminate the threat to patients, protect your teammates, and keep casualties low. You'll need to watch out for your teammates playing the medical role as they triage and resuscitate patients injured by the entities. In the meantime, you'll have to fight off the entity itself - no simple task. If you're feeling extra brave, you can even eliminate the entity entirely for a bit of extra cash and a chance to breathe.

As much fun as it can be fun to directly engage the anomaly, you need to be careful! Some entities can certainly be stopped with a few well-placed 5.56 rounds, but for others all that will do is seal your fate.

Fight for your patients' lives in a detailed medical simulation!

Fancy the medic role? Whether you're applying a pressure dressing to a wound from a Shade tentacle, or splinting a limb broken by debris from a Revenant attack, you will need to fight to keep your patients alive and stable. In the meantime, your teammates will have to cover your back as you triage, treat, and evacuate patients as fast as you can. Start off with a basic automated assessment given by your patient scanner, and as you learn to analyze vital signs and injuries yourself, you will see patient outcomes drastically improve.

S.E.R.T's medical system features a variety of detailed simulations tuned to be plausible while still being fun to play. Blood loss is simulated in real-time, with interventions ranging from wound packing to tourniquets having real benefits and drawbacks. Place an IV catheter in a patient's vein and you can administer medications and transfuse blood to keep them alive and stable until evacuation. In adverse conditions or more remote environments, you'll need to carefully manage your patient's temperature and exposure to keep them on this side of the veil.

Go for a bit of both!

S.E.R.T has no dedicated class system - whatever you're familiar with and can carry, you can use. Want to clear a room by yourself, and treat the patients inside? Go ahead! Want to focus entirely on combat? Load yourself up with armor and a weapon and fight! Favor the support role? Keep your equipment light and move quickly to rescue patients, then make your way out!

data.short_description: Join the Supernatural Emergency Response Team! S.E.R.T is a tactical FPS and medical sim where you fight to rescue the victims of paranormal entities. Enter a location, hold off the entity as long as you can, stabilize the survivors, and get out.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5-series
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 512 MB available space

  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or AMD Ryzen 7-series
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
Patients in-game can be gravely injured by paranormal entities, sometimes in grotesque ways. Amputations and eviscerations are not uncommon and the player must rapidly treat these injuries to save patients.

Players can administer a variety of controlled medications to patients, because they play as licensed medical professionals. Improper use of these medications could lead to adverse effects, overdose, or death.
